steps.title: Getting a quote
steps.say: VOO last traded at {VOO.price} dollars. That's the price for one share. If the market is closed, this is Friday's closing price.

steps.title: Two steps to buy
steps.say: Buying always takes two steps. First I read back the order. Nothing happens until you press Enter or say confirm.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.say: Done. You own one share of VOO with practice money. It settles the next business day.
steps.alt: A short line and a tap.

steps.title: Your portfolio
steps.say: You have {cash} in practice cash and one VOO share worth {value}.

quiz.q: What has to happen before Sonar places a trade?
quiz.why: Every trade needs a spoken or typed confirm after the read-back.
